set.body:
One permitted real memory study must import and complete the production application workflow without dataset-specific Studio source edits. The source files are already available and owner-authorized; this is not an unfulfilled request for any memory dataset.

Acceptance:
- Record chosen CSV roles/units, phase/trial identity, inventory joins, source digests and permission, display/asset declarations, screen/image geometry and timing origin/interval convention. Ground acquisition facts in authoritative source material; retain unresolved facts explicitly and do not infer angular calibration or timing from convenient analysis settings.
- Exercise the standard production host: import/review admission ledger and exclusions, analyze/inspect results, save/reopen and export. Compare the result/accounting with the library API and retain reviewable screenshots. Prior separate-workbench/API experiments do not substitute for this journey.
- Select the existing study whose facts support the required workflow. Retain all exported rows and report exclusion flags separately, per owner instruction, unless the owner changes the policy. Pixel-space/exploratory validation must be labelled accurately; it does not establish unsupported calibrated/temporal claims.

Current evidence: private provenance audit 20261020 establishes Pic_sequences centered757x522 on1024x768 from paper/images, but in-scanner pixels-per-degree and fixation-export onset/boundary settings remain unsupported (historical520px email conflicts). PCMRI contains mixed fixation interval conventions and incomplete retrieval timing declarations. These are admission/provenance questions, not new method-development requirements.

The former combined external-input mote bd-01M4GMYD06NJ8PP3SNGXBH27E4 is consolidated here. Its public ASC input is already satisfied by landed v-asc-e2e/asc-public-fixture/asc-public-e2e. Full vendor certification stays on the post-v1 EyeLink programme. Pic_sequences Procrustes/paper replication is separate research and does not gate G2. Gate stays open until the above production receipt and required declarations are accepted.
